why_ai: Licensed brokers win deals through personal relationships and high-stakes negotiation on unique properties.
why_clarity: Deals are one-off negotiations that take months to close, and brokers each work differently.
why_digital: Comps and modelling are digital, but tours, negotiation and local relationships drive the business.

why_ai: Market report writing is automatable; the firm's private transaction flow and brand give partial protection.
why_clarity: Quarterly reports recur on a fixed cadence, but forecast quality is known only later.
why_digital: Transaction data in and published market reports out, all on screen.

why_ai: Federally regulated lenders require a licensed appraiser to inspect, sign and defend the value opinion.
why_clarity: USPAP approaches are codified and reports recur, but the right value is an opinion.
why_digital: Data and a site inspection feed a written report delivered to lenders.

why_ai: Statutory public office values every parcel, but mass appraisal models are routine and automatable.
why_clarity: IAAO standards and ratio studies define the method and measure accuracy across every parcel.
why_digital: Parcel data modelled on screen, but the buyer is a single local jurisdiction with no choice.

why_ai: Economic impact studies are automatable; advocacy relationships and member data give modest protection.
why_clarity: Impact studies follow standard methods but policy outcomes take years to show.
why_digital: Member surveys in and research out, with some advocacy delivered in person.

why_ai: Lenders accept the principal's local market knowledge, though study assembly is increasingly automatable.
why_clarity: Feasibility studies follow known methods but absorption forecasts are verified years later.
why_digital: Market data and site surveys feed a written study delivered digitally.

why_ai: Phone-verified lease data in a non-disclosure market is a decades-deep moat, though calling is automatable.
why_clarity: Each researcher verifies discrete building facts with a repeatable call script.
why_digital: Phone calls and field photos become a subscription database sold nationally.

why_ai: SEC-regulated ratings committees must stand behind high-stakes credit calls the market prices off.
why_clarity: Published methodologies codify the work, but defaults reveal correctness years later.
why_digital: Loan tapes in and ratings and presale reports out, entirely on screen.

why_ai: Clients pay for independent contrarian calls from known analysts, backed by proprietary series.
why_clarity: Valuation models are structured, but whether a sector call was right takes years.
why_digital: Data in, subscription research out, sold remotely to institutional investors.

why_ai: Commission splits and draw reconciliation are rule-based calculations software can fully automate.
why_clarity: Split rules are explicit and every calculation is instantly checkable.
why_digital: Deal records and split agreements in, ledgers and forecasts out, all in spreadsheets.

why_ai: An Environmental Professional must visit the site and sign the finding that gates the loan.
why_clarity: ASTM E1527 codifies every step, but missed contamination surfaces years later.
why_digital: Records research plus a site walk produce a written Phase I report.

why_ai: Cross-border investors rely on trusted multilingual advisers and attorneys for EB-5 and tax structuring.
why_clarity: Each investor's visa, tax and entity situation differs, with visa outcomes known years later.
why_digital: Documents and WhatsApp coordination are remote by nature, ending in a property transaction.

why_ai: Licensed brokers negotiate high-value site deals using relationships and judgment on physical specs.
why_clarity: Spec matching is structured, but each deal is negotiated and closes over months.
why_digital: Comps are digital, but site tours and local broker relationships drive the deals.

why_ai: Lease abstraction and critical-date tracking are document tasks LLM software already performs.
why_clarity: Lease clauses define exact dates and calculations that recur across every lease.
why_digital: Lease documents in and tracked obligations and reconciliations out, all on screen.

why_ai: Brokerage that depends on relationships and network access, the hardest thing for AI to supply.
why_clarity: Deal sourcing and closing vary by relationship and take months to resolve.
why_digital: Tools are digital, but deal flow comes from in-person networks and referrals.

why_ai: Licensed brokers judge tenant mix and negotiate leases through landlord and tenant relationships.
why_clarity: Lease deals recur more often than sales, but tenant mix judgment is done by feel.
why_digital: CoStar and CRMs are standard, but tours and negotiations stay in person and local.

why_ai: Decades of member-contributed property data no vendor can assemble keep the index irreplaceable.
why_clarity: A published methodology computes the index on fixed quarterly dates.
why_digital: Contributed appraisal data in and return indices out, fully on screen.

why_ai: Small-business buyers need a licensed broker to guide them through property fit and SBA financing.
why_clarity: SBA steps are defined, but property-business fit is judged case by case.
why_digital: Paper-heavy SBA lending and local in-person buyers buying a physical building.

why_ai: Engineers must physically walk each building and inspect every major system on site.
why_clarity: ASTM E2018 defines the assessment, but remaining-life estimates prove out years later.
why_digital: On-site inspection is the core work; only the final report is digital.

why_ai: Appeals are adversarial against assessors and boards, with hearings and litigation under hard deadlines.
why_clarity: Success is a measurable dollar reduction, though argument choice varies by board.
why_digital: Assessment data in and filings out, with some board hearings attended in person.

why_ai: Index building is automatable analytics, protected only by the platform's proprietary pipeline data.
why_clarity: Demand indices are computed by a fixed method on a regular cadence.
why_digital: Platform data in and indices and dashboards out, all software.

why_ai: Deal flow depends on personal local networks and judgment where comparable sales barely exist.
why_clarity: A town sees a handful of varied transactions a year, so little repeats.
why_digital: Local, face-to-face markets without CoStar, relying on assessor sites and personal contacts.
